page.overview:
What is Dur?

, or The Dur was a bushy, canyon filled, jungle planet outside the Known Universe, which was inhabited during Scattering. The planet was home to the Frame bush, a semi-sentient plant that could morph into biological architecture. The phrase 'Holy rock of Dur', and variations thereof, was commonly used. The Honored Matres often used the phrase. They also used the phrase 'Dear Gods of Dur', indicating that there was some form of religion on the planet. At some point, Great Honored Matre Dama lived on the planet. She reminisced of a simpler time on Dur, without Futars. She compared the interior of the control center on Junction to that of Dur.

The planet had a military force. Jafa Muzzafar was the leader of the Forces of Dur. The title Field Marshal was a title used during the ancient times of Dur.
